title: Royalty OS Trace Event v3.0
description: A machine-readable trace event schema for recording authorized AI retrieval, reference, influence, verification, and allocation-readiness signals in Royalty OS v3.0.

schema_version.description: Version of the Royalty OS Trace Event schema.

trace_id.description: Unique identifier for this trace event.

content_os_id.description: Royalty OS content identifier for the referenced work, fragment, concept, or structure.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the trace event in RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time format.

session_id.description: Optional anonymized session identifier. Raw user identity should not be stored here.

trace_context.description: Contextual metadata about where and how the trace event occurred.

environment.description: Operational environment in which the trace was recorded.

trace_source.description: Primary source from which this trace event was generated.

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction or region relevant to this trace event, such as JP, EU, US, or global.

actor.description: AI system, provider, or deployment context involved in the usage event.

ai_model_id.description: Identifier of the AI model, system, or agent that performed the retrieval or usage.

provider_id.description: Identifier of the AI provider, platform, application, or system operator.

deployment_context.description: Deployment context in which the usage occurred.

system_role.description: Functional role of the AI component in the trace event.

retrieval.description: Retrieval-level evidence about the referenced content.

retrieval_score.description: Similarity, relevance, or retrieval confidence score.

retrieval_granularity.description: Granularity level at which the content was retrieved or matched.

retrieved_fragment_hash.description: Hash of the retrieved fragment, if available.

retrieved_fragment_length.description: Length of the retrieved fragment in tokens, characters, or implementation-defined units.

retrieval_rank.description: Rank position of the retrieved item in the retrieval result set.

retrieval_method.description: Retrieval method used to identify the referenced content.

usage.description: How the retrieved or referenced content was used by the AI system.

usage_type.description: Type of usage inferred or recorded for the referenced content.

output_fragment_hash.description: Hash of the output fragment influenced by the referenced content, if available.

output_granularity.description: Granularity of the output region associated with this trace event.

citation_visible_to_user.description: Whether the AI output exposed a visible citation, link, attribution, or source reference to the end user.

human_visible_use.description: Whether the usage was visible in the final user-facing output.

permission.description: Permission and licensing status relevant to the usage event.

permission_scope.description: Declared or detected permission scope for this content.

permission_status.description: Operational status of the permission at the time of usage.

license_uri.description: URI of the relevant license, permission policy, or rights statement.

permission_evidence_hash.description: Hash of permission evidence or policy snapshot.

verification.description: Verification signals supporting the authenticity and attribution relevance of the trace event.

watermark_detected.description: Whether a watermark or watermark-like signal was detected.

c2pa_manifest_detected.description: Whether a C2PA-style manifest or provenance metadata was detected.

soft_binding_resolved.description: Whether soft binding to an external manifest, registry, or provenance record was resolved.

retrieval_log_confirmed.description: Whether the usage was confirmed by a retrieval or system log.

outlier_origin_detected.description: Whether the content, concept, or structure was identified as a statistical or semantic outlier origin.

verification_confidence.description: Overall confidence score for verification of the trace event.

verification_methods.description: Verification methods used to support this trace event.

attribution.description: Attribution-related scores and readiness status for downstream review or allocation.

influence_estimate.description: Estimated degree of influence on the AI output or system behavior.

origin_score.description: Estimated originality or origin relevance score of the referenced content, concept, or structure.

attribution_confidence.description: Confidence in the attribution relationship between the source and the output.

allocation_readiness.description: Readiness status for downstream allocation review.

attribution_method.description: Method used to estimate attribution or influence.

privacy.description: Privacy-preserving controls applied to this trace event.

user_prompt_stored.description: Whether the raw user prompt was stored.

user_identity_stored.description: Whether directly identifying user information was stored.

anonymized_session.description: Whether the session identifier is anonymized or pseudonymized.

raw_content_stored.description: Whether raw referenced content was stored in the trace record.

privacy_mode.description: Privacy mode applied to the trace event.

evidence.description: Optional evidence bundle references associated with this trace event.

evidence_bundle_id.description: Identifier of an external evidence bundle, audit package, or trace receipt.

manifest_uri.description: URI of an external manifest, provenance record, or trace receipt.

audit_log_uri.description: URI of an external audit log or provider-side trace record.
